title: Tech Note: Query and Access Date-and-Time in the era of ORDA

historical_commentary.text: ORDA-based date/time querying on entity selections and collections is a durable, still-current 4D pattern; nothing about querying/filtering dates by month, day, hour, minute, or second via ORDA has been deprecated since 2019. Only the full walkthrough/code detail is unavailable here since the sample database's full text could not be retrieved.
related_updates: ORDA query and filtering techniques for date/time fields remain fully current in 4D today
